timeline.message:
Safe-guard against broken client environments

The code previously threw StringIndexOutOfBoundsException if the client
env contained just a variable name with no '=' or value.

Fixed #3196.

Change-Id: I5afcaa398ab2e8bacc709445f50ba363659cadbb

timeline.body:
You could just use `m.group()` here, which would be equivalent to `--client_env=m.group(1)=`. So this code could be simplified to

```
buf.append(m.group()).append("__private_value_removed__").
```
I'll import this change and merge it with the (internally) existing BlazeRuntimeTest, and open source the other tests we already have. I'll address the comments in the internal review.
